EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a very strong aromatic ring-breathing band at ~1009 cm⁻¹ and an intense aromatic C–H stretch at 3073 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), consistent with a phenyl ring. A prominent band at 1680 cm⁻¹ supports a conjugated carbonyl (aldehyde) C=O, and the strong feature near 1180 cm⁻¹ matches typical phenolic C–O stretching in substituted phenols. The peaks at ~835 and 771 cm⁻¹ are characteristic aromatic C–H out-of-plane deformations for multi-substituted rings. Critically, a distinct band at 620 cm⁻¹ is compatible with an aryl–Br stretch, favoring a brominated aromatic carbonyl over non-halogenated candidates. These features together best match O=Cc1cc(O)ccc1Br (6).
